void md_kernel(double force_x[256],double force_y[256],double force_z[256],double position_x[256],double position_y[256],double position_z[256],int NL[4096])

  double j_x;
  double j_y;

  double i_x;

  int i;
  int j;
  int jidx;
  
#pragma ACCEL PIPELINE auto{__PIPE__L0}
  
#pragma ACCEL TILE FACTOR=auto{__TILE__L0}
  
#pragma ACCEL PARALLEL FACTOR=auto{__PARA__L0}
  loop_i:
  for (i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
    i_x = position_x[i];
    i_y = position_y[i];
    i_z = position_z[i];
    fx = ((double )0);
    fy = ((double )0);
    fz = ((double )0);
    loop_j:
    for (j = 0; j < 16; j++) {
// Get neighbor
      jidx = NL[i * 16 + j];
// Look up x,y,z positions
      j_x = position_x[jidx];
      j_y = position_y[jidx];
      j_z = position_z[jidx];
// Calc distance
      delx = i_x - j_x;
      dely = i_y - j_y;
      delz = i_z - j_z;
      r2inv = 1.0 / (delx * delx + dely * dely + delz * delz);
// Assume no cutoff and aways account for all nodes in area

      potential = r6inv * (1.5 * r6inv - 2.0);
// Sum changes in force
      force = r2inv * potential;
      fx += delx * force;
      fy += dely * force;
      fz += delz * force;
    }
//Update forces after all neighbors accounted for.
    force_x[i] = fx;
    force_y[i] = fy;

def get_function_info(filepath):

    func_match = re.search(r'#pragma ACCEL kernel\s*\n\s*(void\s+\w+)\s*\((.*?)\)', content, re.DOTALL)

#include <stdlib.h>
#include <math.h>

// Testbench for {func_name}
int main() {{

"""

        if param['is_array']:

            if len(dims) == 2:

                tb_content += f"    // Initialize {param['name']}\\n"
                tb_content += f"    for (int i = 0; i < {dims[0]}; i++)\\n"
                tb_content += f"        for (int j = 0; j < {dims[1]}; j++)\\n"
                tb_content += f"            {param['name']}[i][j] = ({param['type']})(i * {dims[1]} + j);\\n"
            else:
                tb_content += f"    {param['type']} {param['name']}[{dims[0]}];\n"
                tb_content += f"    // Initialize {param['name']}\\n"
                tb_content += f"    for (int i = 0; i < {dims[0]}; i++)\\n"
                tb_content += f"        {param['name']}[i] = ({param['type']})i;\\n"
        else:
            if param['type'] == 'int':
                tb_content += f"    {param['type']} {param['name']} = 100;\n"

                tb_content += f"    {param['type']} {param['name']} = 1.0;\n"
    
    # Call the function
    tb_content += f"\\n    // Call the DUT\\n"
    tb_content += f"    {func_name}("

    tb_content += ");\n\n"
    
    # Add verification
    tb_content += "    // Verify results (basic check)\\n"
    tb_content += "    printf(\"Testbench completed successfully\\n\");\n"
    tb_content += "    return 0;\n}\n"

def generate_documentation(design_info, src_path, category):
    """Generate documentation for the design"""
    func_name = design_info['name']
    params = design_info['params']
    
    doc = f"""# Design Documentation: {func_name}

## Overview
This is an HLS design from the HARP benchmark suite.

## Category
{category}

## Function Signature
```c
void {func_name}(
"""
    for i, param in enumerate(params):
        if param['is_array']:
            dims = param['dims']
            if len(dims) == 2:
                doc += f"    {param['type']} {param['name']}[{dims[0]}][{dims[1]}]"
            else:
                doc += f"    {param['type']} {param['name']}[{dims[0]}]"

add_files -tb tb_{design_name}.cpp

    """Compile the design with clang"""
    log_file = os.path.join(design_dir, "compile_log.txt")
    
    # Build include paths
    include_paths = [stubs_path] if os.path.exists(stubs_path) else []
    include_args = [f"-I{p}" for p in include_paths]
    
    cmd = ["clang", "-c", "-fsyntax-only"] + include_args + [src_path]
    
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        with open(log_file, 'w') as f:
            if result.returncode == 0:
                f.write("Compilation: SUCCESS\\n")
                f.write("Command: " + " ".join(cmd) + "\\n\\n")
                f.write("No errors found.\\n")
                return True
            else:
                f.write("Compilation: FAILED\\n")
                f.write("Command: " + " ".join(cmd) + "\\n\\n")
                f.write("STDOUT:\\n" + result.stdout + "\\n\\n")
                f.write("STDERR:\\n" + result.stderr + "\\n")
                return False

    if '/machsuite/' in src_path:
        category = 'machsuite'
    elif '/poly/' in src_path:
        category = 'poly'
    else:

    # Create design directory
    design_dir = os.path.join(output_base, design_name)
    os.makedirs(design_dir, exist_ok=True)
    
    # Copy source file
    dst_src = os.path.join(design_dir, src_name)
    shutil.copy2(src_path, dst_src)
    
    # Get function info
    design_info = get_function_info(src_path)
    if not design_info:
        print(f"Warning: Could not parse {src_path}")
        return None
    
    # Generate testbench
    tb_content = generate_testbench(design_info, src_name)
    tb_path = os.path.join(design_dir, f"tb_{design_name}.cpp")
    with open(tb_path, 'w') as f:
        f.write(tb_content)
    
    # Generate documentation
    doc_content = generate_documentation(design_info, src_path, category)
    doc_path = os.path.join(design_dir, "README.md")
    with open(doc_path, 'w') as f:

    with open(tcl_path, 'w') as f:

    compile_success = compile_design(dst_src, design_dir, STUBS_PATH)
    
    return {
        'name': design_name,
        'category': category,
        'function': design_info['name'],
        'source': src_name,
        'testbench': f"tb_{design_name}.cpp",
        'documentation': "README.md",
        'tcl_script': f"synth_{design_name}.tcl",
        'compile_success': compile_success
    }

def main():
    # Create output directory
    os.makedirs(OUTPUT_PATH, exist_ok=True)
    
    # Find all kernel files
    kernel_files = []
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(REPO_PATH):
